playstyle: Gryselle's Arenai puts five agile Order fighters on the board with 2-dodge saves and three to four health each—mobile but fragile. Retaria's Fly and Move values of four to five across the warband let it project threat anywhere and choose its fights. The warband can inspire by flooding enemy territory with treasure tokens or by fighting defensively in friendly hexes where flanking is impossible. Either way it wins by exploiting superior speed to isolate targets and bury them under high-dice attacks before losses mount.
